name: Pittsford Plaza
summary: Pittsford Plaza is a well-regarded community shopping center in upscale Pittsford, New York, featuring popular national retailers like Bath & Body Works, Michaels, Ulta Beauty, and Pearle Vision. The plaza serves as a convenient retail hub for the affluent Rochester suburb with diverse shopping and dining options including the newly opened Mamma G's restaurant.
demographics: Pittsford Plaza serves an affluent suburban Rochester market, drawing primarily from the upscale Pittsford community and surrounding Monroe County neighborhoods. The trade area attracts middle to upper-income families and professionals, with household incomes significantly above the regional average. Shoppers tend to be educated, quality-conscious consumers seeking convenient access to specialty retail, personal services, and dining options. The center appeals to a broad age range from young families to established empty-nesters who value the plaza's mix of national retailers and local businesses.
description: Pittsford Plaza stands as a prominent shopping destination in the affluent Rochester suburb of Pittsford, New York, serving the community from its location at 3349 Monroe Avenue. This well-established community center has become a cornerstone of local retail activity, offering residents convenient access to a diverse mix of national retailers and specialty stores. The plaza features popular tenants including Bath & Body Works, Michaels, Ulta Beauty, and Pearle Vision, alongside dining options like the recently opened Mamma G's restaurant. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Pittsford Plaza provides a comfortable shopping environment that caters to the needs of the surrounding upscale community. The center maintains strong customer satisfaction with a 4.4-star rating from over 4,000 reviews, reflecting its role as a trusted retail hub where quality service and tenant variety meet the expectations of discerning Monroe County shoppers.
